## Foo

Foo is a program you start from its icon or from a terminal. Write here, in one or two sentences, what you use it for.

This manual has three pages:

- [Welcome](index.md), this page.
- [Using Foo](usage.md) explains how to start and use the program.
- [Troubleshooting](troubleshooting.md) lists problems and what to do about them.
